evaluation.overall_comment: The translation covers the entire dialogue and preserves the core scientific narrative, but it is heavily marred by pervasive typographical errors, inconsistent spelling, grammatical inaccuracies, and awkward phrasing. These linguistic flaws significantly disrupt readability and natural flow, requiring substantial proofreading and editorial refinement to reach a professional standard. While the structure is maintained and no content is omitted, the quality falls into the major defects category due to persistent language issues that hinder comprehension and fluency.
